_comment: PINNED build profile for the live serving collection. Recurring generic ingesters resolve their default chunker from this file. Candidate structured runs require AW_CHUNKER=structured plus an explicit versioned policy path, exact byte SHA, and immutable tokenizer revision. At a chunk-epoch alias flip, change mode/policy-path/policy-SHA/tokenizer-revision/epoch/legend atomically in the same release. weekly_delta v1 deliberately refuses non-legacy epochs until its URL-addressed writer is replaced.
